Interface ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks

Enclosing class:
ImportOrchestrator
public static interface ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks
All UI notification points for a single import run.

All methods are called on the background thread. Implementations must dispatch to the JavaFX thread where necessary.
